stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,NULL AS alias,ast_module AS module,NULL AS value,NULL AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(ast_breadth_order,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(ast_index,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(ast_end,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,NULL AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,NULL AS context,NULL AS name_repr,NULL AS value_repr,ast_annotation AS annotation,ast_annotation_repr AS annotation_repr FROM canonical

stages.name: calls
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.name AS callee,f.id AS callee_id,r.id AS receiver,r.kind AS receiver_kind,r.name AS receiver_name
      FROM a c JOIN a f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.parent=c.id AND f.field='func'
      LEFT JOIN a r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.parent=f.id AND r.field='value'
      WHERE c.kind='Call'

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: methods
stages.query: SELECT f.*,c.name AS class_name FROM functions f JOIN a c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.id=f.parent AND c.kind='ClassDef' WHERE f.field='body'

stages.name: imports
stages.query: SELECT n.*,CASE WHEN n.kind='ImportFrom' THEN n.module ELSE (SELECT group_concat(s.name,',') FROM (SELECT name FROM a s WHERE s.__path=n.__path AND s.parent=n.id AND s.kind='alias' ORDER BY position) s) END AS imported FROM a n WHERE n.kind IN ('Import','ImportFrom')

stages.name: composition_methods
stages.query: SELECT m.* FROM methods m JOIN a c ON c.__path=m.__path AND c.id=m.parent WHERE m.class_name='SemanticPlanBuilder' AND c.parent=0 AND m.kind='FunctionDef'

stages.name: actual_annotations
stages.query: SELECT id AS record_id,0 AS ordinal,imported AS annotation FROM imports

stages.name: annotation_reprs
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE chars(record_id,ordinal,value,delimiter,position,piece) AS (
      SELECT record_id,ordinal,annotation,CASE WHEN instr(annotation,'''')>0 AND instr(annotation,'"')=0 THEN '"' ELSE '''' END,0,'' FROM actual_annotations
      UNION ALL SELECT record_id,ordinal,value,delimiter,position+1,
        CASE WHEN substr(value,position+1,1)='\' THEN '\\'
          WHEN substr(value,position+1,1)=delimiter THEN '\'||delimiter
          WHEN unicode(substr(value,position+1,1))=9 THEN '\t'
          WHEN unicode(substr(value,position+1,1))=10 THEN '\n'
          WHEN unicode(substr(value,position+1,1))=13 THEN '\r'
          WHEN substr(value,position+1,1)!=' ' AND rx_matches(substr(value,position+1,1),'^[\p{C}\p{Z}]$') THEN
            CASE WHEN unicode(substr(value,position+1,1))<256 THEN printf('\x%02x',unicode(substr(value,position+1,1)))
                 WHEN unicode(substr(value,position+1,1))<65536 THEN printf('\u%04x',unicode(substr(value,position+1,1)))
                 ELSE printf('\U%08x',unicode(substr(value,position+1,1))) END
          ELSE substr(value,position+1,1) END
      FROM chars WHERE position<length(value))
      SELECT record_id,ordinal,delimiter||group_concat(piece,'')||delimiter repr FROM
        (SELECT * FROM chars ORDER BY record_id,ordinal,position) GROUP BY record_id,ordinal,delimiter

relational.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'SPC-001' AS issue,'semantic plan imports runtime module '||r.repr AS message,n.id||':SPC-001:'||(n.bfs) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.bfs AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM imports n JOIN annotation_reprs r ON r.record_id=n.id WHERE instr(n.imported,'cache')>0 OR instr(n.imported,'connection')>0 OR instr(n.imported,'executor')>0 OR instr(n.imported,'plan_flush')>0 OR instr(n.imported,'runtime_services')>0 OR instr(n.imported,'transaction')>0 OR substr(n.imported,-12)='.lazy_result' OR substr(n.imported,-9)='.lazy_seq' UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'SPC-002' AS issue,'semantic field uses runtime type '||v.annotation_repr AS message,n.id||':SPC-002:'||(n.bfs) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.bfs AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM a n JOIN a v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id AND v.field='annotation' WHERE n.kind='AnnAssign' AND (instr(v.annotation,'Connection')>0 OR instr(v.annotation,'Cursor')>0 OR instr(v.annotation,'Executor')>0 OR instr(v.annotation,'LazyResult')>0 OR instr(v.annotation,'PlanFlushContext')>0 OR instr(v.annotation,'Transaction')>0) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'SPC-004' AS issue,'semantic builder exposes mutable return from '||n.name AS message,n.id||':SPC-004:'||(n.id) AS identity,1 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM composition_methods n WHERE substr(n.name,1,1)!='_' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a v LEFT JOIN a root ON root.__path=v.__path AND root.parent=v.id AND root.field='value' WHERE v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id AND v.field='returns' AND (v.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') AND v.name IN ('dict','list','set') OR v.kind='Subscript' AND root.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') AND root.name IN ('dict','list','set'))) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'SPC-003' AS issue,'semantic builder calls runtime terminal '||n.callee AS message,n.id||':SPC-003:'||(m.id+n.bfs*0.000001+0.000001) AS identity,1 AS phase,m.id+n.bfs*0.000001+0.000001 AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM composition_methods m JOIN calls n ON n.__path=m.__path AND n.id BETWEEN m.id AND m.last WHERE n.callee_kind='Attribute' AND n.callee IN ('commit','execute','execute_async','execute_sync','resolve','resolve_async','rollback') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'SPC-005' AS issue,'fragment import must use typed exact ref remapping' AS message,n.id||':SPC-005:'||((SELECT cls.last FROM a cls WHERE cls.__path=n.__path AND cls.id=n.parent)+0.999999) AS identity,1 AS phase,(SELECT cls.last FROM a cls WHERE cls.__path=n.__path AND cls.id=n.parent)+0.999999 AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM composition_methods n WHERE n.name='add_fragment' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM composition_methods m WHERE m.__path=n.__path AND m.parent=n.parent AND m.name='add_fragment' AND m.id<n.id) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a n2 WHERE n2.__path=n.__path AND n2.id BETWEEN n.id AND n.last AND (n2.kind='Name' AND n2.name='RefRemap')) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a n2 WHERE n2.__path=n.__path AND n2.id BETWEEN n.id AND n.last AND (n2.kind='Name' AND n2.name='rewrite_exact_plan_refs_payload')))

cases.all:
SELECT CASE WHEN json_type(data,'$.fingerprints')='array' AND json_array_length(data,'$.fingerprints')=2
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(data,'$.fingerprints') WHERE type!='text')
      AND json_type(data,'$.firstRefs')='array' AND json_type(data,'$.secondRefs')='array'
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(data,'$.firstRefs') WHERE type!='text')
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(data,'$.secondRefs') WHERE type!='text')
      THEN data ELSE json_extract('[]','$[composition observations required]') END data FROM supplied
